additional_identities.status: full cells retained but repeated marks not duplicated in equipment identity index.

additional_identities.status: type schedule rows, not installed outlet/damper-actuator quantities.

additional_identities.classification: Air Operations, MTRACON and ATCT heating/chilled-water control-valve schedule rows
additional_identities.status: literal valve unit/mark, GPM, size, configuration and Cv fields retained.

reconciliation_findings: Air Operations DOAH-A1/A2 and MTRACON DOAH-M1 are each printed across two source schedule parts; the first part establishes schedule identity and the companion part remains retained as performance/electrical detail.
Air Operations fan sound-power rows reuse AHU/DOAH marks already present in equipment schedules, so they remain supplemental acoustic detail rather than duplicate equipment identities.
The Air Operations and MTRACON GRD marks are type schedules. No plan-symbol count, actuator count or BAS terminal count is derived from them.

The supplied control-valve tables provide 167 literal valve rows across three building scopes. Their source table row is retained rather than treating a valve mark as a standalone physical device without its unit/scope context.

control_valve_schedule.note: Six printed source tables cover Air Operations, MTRACON and ATCT heating/chilled-water control valves.

damper_actuator_schedule.note: The set has damper/actuator symbols and sequence behavior, but no table with damper-actuator tag, selected make/model, torque, signal or fail action.
